architecture.ownershipLaw: Harness execution disposition is not Agent semantic conclusion. Harness-owned no_progress carries its reason in Run stop detail/Trace and does not synthesize AgentRunConclusion.
architecture.structuredCompletionLaw: A non-null AgentRunConclusion under structured-result-v1 remains caller-schema structured output. Harness execution stop reasons must not masquerade as that result representation.
architecture.recorderLaw: NO_PROGRESS remains pause-like for IndependentRunRecorder and does not create a terminal result/CompletionProposal; this patch changes only the Loop conclusion surface.
architecture.modeNeutralityLaw: The fix does not make OrdivonAgentLoop completion-mode aware and does not special-case structured-result-v1. It removes a Harness-authored semantic conclusion from one Harness-owned execution stop for all modes.
architecture.effectLaw: The observation gate, Tool availability, Tool accounting, WorkingSet transition semantics and physical Runtime dispatch behavior remain unchanged.

reproduction.rawConclusionSummary: external observation gate closed after 1 consecutive observation-only turns without a mutation, check, or conclusion
reproduction.interpretation: The structured representation failure was printed before the probe assertion failed. The failed process status does not invalidate the reproduced output; the later assertion only showed that StandaloneHarnessExecution.paused is not the same fact as durable HarnessRunStatus.PAUSED.

implementation.removedBehavior: external-observation-gate NO_PROGRESS no longer synthesizes needs_input AgentRunConclusion
implementation.retainedBehavior: NO_PROGRESS detail still includes the closed-gate reason plus the attempted post-gate Tool request; Trace still records run_stopped.

conclusion: The Finance dogfood non-decodable structured conclusion is now reproduced deterministically as a Harness-owned NO_PROGRESS fallback. The smallest repair is ownership-correct rather than structured-mode-specific: NO_PROGRESS is execution disposition, so Harness retains its reason in stop detail/Trace and returns no Agent conclusion. This removes the plain-text fallback that violated caller-bound structured result representation while preserving the existing observation gate and resume mechanics.
knownLimits: StandaloneHarnessExecution.paused remains defined as terminal_result is None and can coexist with a durable Run projection still marked active. This task observed that naming/state distinction but does not classify it as a bug.
The durable recorder remains pause-like for NO_PROGRESS and does not produce a terminal result. This patch does not change recorder status transitions.
The fix does not guarantee an Agent will eventually submit candidate_completed or needs_input; it only prevents Harness from fabricating that semantic conclusion on the Agent's behalf.
The patch is mode-neutral. Plain completion callers also no longer receive the synthetic NO_PROGRESS needs_input conclusion.
